items.headline: Trump: Iran par hamla 'highly unlikely'
items.detail: Trump ne CNN ko kaha — Iran se vaarta me pragati rahi to dobara hamla 'highly unlikely'; mazboot samjhote par nirbhar; saath hi chetavani di — 38 pulon samet lakshya tay hain, teen vimanvahak taiyaar; Iran ke videsh mantri ne vaarta ruki rehne ki baat kahi.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran parmanu vaarta aur Hormuz — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Nvidia: CEO Huang par jaanch shuru
items.detail: Nvidia board ne CEO Jensen Huang par swatantra jaanch shuru ki — aarop hai ki ve ek mahila ke sampark me the jise America cheeni jasusi se jodta hai; Huang ne staff ko patra me sambandh sweekara, board ko abhi koi raaz leak hone ka saboot nahi mila, ve CEO bane rahenge.
items.exam_angle: AI chip niryat niyantran aur America-China tech takraav — arthvyavastha aur antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Giza: Train takkar me 7 ki maut, 112 ghayal
items.detail: Giza ke Al-Ayyat jile me Giza-Fayoum train peeche se Cairo-Aswan train se takrayi, ek train patri se utri; swasthya mantralaya ke mutabik 7 ki maut, 112 ghayal, 45 ko aspatal se chhutti; Rashtrapati Sisi ne jaanch ka aadesh diya. (Updated: pehle 64 ghayal bataye gaye the, maut ki pushti nahi hui thi.)
items.exam_angle: Rail suraksha aur haadsa prabandhan — parivahan aur shasan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Abu Dhabi vaarta me Europe bhi shamil
items.detail: France ke videsh mantri ne kaha — 10-11 November ko Abu Dhabi me America ki madhyasthata wali Ukraine-Russia vaarta me Europe bhi hissa lega; Witkoff dono deshon ke pratinidhimandalon ko ek saath laayenge.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh aur shanti vaarta me Europe ki bhumika — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Eisenkot ko Israel sarkar banane ka mauka
items.detail: Rashtrapati Herzog ne Gadi Eisenkot ko sarkar banane ka pehla mauka diya — 67 sansadon ne unka samarthan kiya, Netanyahu ko 46 mile; Eisenkot ke paas 28 din hain, bahumat ke liye 61 vote chahiye.
items.exam_angle: Israel me sarkar gathan aur Knesset ganit — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Ronen Horesh / Knesset Archives, Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)

items.headline: Sanaa ke paas hamle me 33 ki maut
items.detail: Houthi swasthya mantralaya ke anusaar, Sanaa ke paas Bani Hushaysh me hawai hamle me kam se kam 33 log maare gaye, 39 ghayal — marne walon me 13 bachche; Houthi ne Saudi Arabia ko zimmedaar thahraya, Riyadh ne jaanch ki baat kahi, Reuters swatantra pushti nahi kar saka.
items.exam_angle: Yemen me phir bhadka sangharsh aur Saudi-Houthi takraav — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Congo: Ebola clinic par hamla, mareez bhaage
items.detail: Congo ke North Kivu me Cantine gaon par raat ke hamle me kam se kam 33 nagrik maare gaye; ADF ko zimmedaar thahraya gaya — paas ke Kelekele aspatal se lagbhag 180 mareez bhaag nikle, jinme Ebola ka ek pusht aur paanch sandeh wale mareez bhi the.
items.exam_angle: Congo me Ebola prakop aur sashastra hinsa — swasthya aur antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Japan: 5.7 ka bhookamp, 22 ghayal
items.detail: Madhya Japan me subah 1:04 baje 5.7 teevrata ka bhookamp aaya — kam se kam 22 log ghayal, dukaanon ke sheeshe toote, rail sewayein ruki; JMA ne aane wale dinon me tez jhatkon ki chetavani di, tsunami ki chetavani nahi.
items.exam_angle: Japan me bhookamp aur JMA ki chetavani — bhugol aur aapda prabandhan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America ne Iron Gate task force banayi
items.detail: CENTCOM ne shanivaar ko Task Force Iron Gate banayi — Iran ke zameeni raston se hathiyar aur pratibandhit saaman ki aawajahi rokne ke liye; Tampa me lagbhag 20 logon ki team, samudri naakabandi ke saath-saath zameen aur Caspian Sea par nazar rakhegi.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav aur naakabandi — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Pope Leo Argentina pahunche, Milei ko sandesh
items.detail: Pope Leo XIV ravivaar ko Buenos Aires pahunche — lagbhag 40 saal me pehli papal yatra; unhone kaha arthvyavastha ko insaan ki seva karni chahiye, Milei ki katauti neeti par narmi se sawaal uthaye.
items.exam_angle: Pope Leo XIV ki pehli Latin America yatra aur Vatican ki bhoomika — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump aaj Qatar ke PM se milenge
items.detail: Trump aaj White House me Qatar ke PM Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani se milenge — Qatar Iran se vaarta me naye prastaav laa raha hai; Rubio ne kaha vaarta me khaas pragati nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran parmanu vaarta me Qatar ki madhyasthata — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Nigeria ne U-17 Mahila World Cup jeeta
items.detail: Nigeria ne Japan ko 2-1 se haraakar FIFA U-17 Mahila World Cup jeeta — Africa ki pehli team jisne mahila FIFA khitaab jeeta; Bashiru aur Umejiaku ne goal kiye, Umejiaku ko Golden Ball mila.
items.exam_angle: FIFA U-17 Mahila World Cup 2026 aur Africa ki pehli jeet — khel ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump: APEC me Xi-Putin se milenge
items.detail: Trump ne kaha — 18-19 November ko Shenzhen me APEC shikhar par Xi Jinping aur Vladimir Putin se milne ki ummeed hai; Iran yuddh khatm karne aur parmanu nishastrikaran par baat hogi.
items.exam_angle: America-China-Russia trilateral vaarta aur parmanu nishastrikaran — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iraq: Iran seema band karne ki maang
items.detail: America ke Vitt Mantralaya ne Iraq se Iran se lagti lagbhag sabhi seema chaukiyan band karne ko kaha, sirf do khuli rahengi; Iraq ke Videsh Mantri Fuad Hussein ne kaha band karna mushkil hai aur arthvyavastha par asar padega, baatcheet jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav me Iraq ki bhoomika aur arthik pratibandh — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: U.S. Department of State, public domain (Wikimedia Commons)
